title: Elapsed time, including across midnight
blurb: Find the time between two clock readings, add or subtract a duration, cross midnight without losing a day, and switch between minutes, hours and decimal hours.
question: A night-shift nurse starts at 1915 and leaves at 0745 the next morning. How long was the shift, and what time is it 9 hours 50 minutes after 1915?

teach.body: Formally, elapsed time is the duration between a start time and an end time, measured in hours and minutes, where 1 hour = 60 minutes and 1 day = 24 hours. In plain English: it is how long something lasted. The catch is that clock arithmetic is base 60 for minutes and base 24 for hours, so the borrowing and carrying you learned for ordinary numbers (in tens and hundreds) gives wrong answers here.

teach.h: Subtract hours and minutes separately; borrow 60
teach.body: Write the end time over the start time and subtract minutes from minutes and hours from hours. If the end minutes are smaller, borrow 1 hour from the hours and add 60 (not 100) to the minutes. 1620 - 0845: 20 is less than 45, so 16 h 20 min becomes 15 h 80 min. 15 h 80 min - 8 h 45 min = 7 h 35 min.

teach.caption: Minutes can never reach 60 in an answer. If you see one, you treated an hour as 100 minutes.
Or add 24 hours to the end time (0525 becomes 2925) and subtract as usual: 2925 - 2140 = 7 h 45 min.

teach.h: Adding a duration and wrapping past 2400
items: Add minutes to minutes and hours to hours: 1915 + 9 h 50 min = 28 h 65 min.
Carry: 65 min = 1 h 5 min, so 28 h 65 min = 29 h 05 min.
Wrap: past 24 hours, subtract 24. 29 - 24 = 5, so 0505 the next morning.

Counting back works the same way: 0815 - 6 h 30 min = 7 h 75 min - 6 h 30 min = 1 h 45 min, so 0145. If counting back would pass 0000, add 24 h to the start time first: 0200 - 3 h = 2600 - 3 h = 2300 the evening before.

head: Decimal hours
Minutes
teach.caption: Minutes to decimal hours: divide by 60. 105 min ÷ 60 = 1.75 h; 1 h 45 min is NOT 1.45 h.

teach.h: Scenario: Malik works out his shift
teach.body: Malik, a nursing assistant applying to a BSN program, starts a night shift at 1915 and leaves at 0745. To midnight: 2400 - 1915 = 4 h 45 min (borrow 60: 23 h 60 min - 19 h 15 min). After midnight: 7 h 45 min. Total: 11 h 90 min = 12 h 30 min. A tube feeding he starts at 1915 for 9 h 50 min ends at 28 h 65 min = 29 h 05 min, minus 24 = 0505.

teach.text: The elapsed-time traps: borrowing or carrying 100 instead of 60, subtracting the earlier clock reading from the later one when the span crosses midnight, forgetting to subtract 24 after passing 2400, dropping the carried hour (65 minutes written as 05 with no extra hour), and reading decimal hours as minutes (1.6 h as 1 h 60 min, or 1.75 h as 1 h 75 min).

items: Subtract minutes from minutes and hours from hours; borrow 1 h = 60 min.
Across midnight: time to 0000 + time after 0000, or add 24 h to the end time.
Adding: carry 60 minutes into 1 hour; past 2400, subtract 24 for the next day.
Decimal hours to minutes: × 60. Minutes to hours: ÷ 60.
Check by adding the duration back to the start time.

summary: You can now find elapsed time by subtracting hours and minutes with 60-minute borrowing, including spans that cross midnight. You can also add or subtract a duration, wrap past 2400 correctly, and convert between minutes and decimal hours.

A.q: How much time passes from 0835 to 1410?
A.why: Borrow 1 hour: 14 h 10 min = 13 h 70 min. 13 h 70 min - 8 h 35 min = 5 h 35 min. Check: 0835 + 5 h 35 min = 1410.

whyNot.0: This counts 0835 to 1400 (5 h 25 min) and leaves out the 10 minutes after 1400.
whyNot.2: This subtracts like ordinary numbers (1410 - 835 = 575), then reads 5 h 75 min as 6 h 15 min.
whyNot.3: This subtracts 10 from 35 instead of borrowing an hour (14 - 8 = 6, 35 - 10 = 25).

A.q: What time is 2 h 45 min after 1030?
A.why: 10 h 30 min + 2 h 45 min = 12 h 75 min. 75 min = 1 h 15 min, so 13 h 15 min: 1315.

whyNot.0: 1:15 is right, but it is p.m., so it is written 1315 in military time, not 0115.
whyNot.1: This turns 75 minutes into 15 minutes without carrying the hour.
whyNot.3: This carries 2 hours; 75 minutes is 1 hour 15 minutes.

A.q: How many minutes are in 2.3 hours?

whyNot.0: This reads 2.3 hours as 2 hours 3 minutes.
whyNot.2: This reads 0.3 hour as 30 minutes; 0.3 × 60 = 18 minutes.
whyNot.3: This multiplies by 100, as if an hour had 100 minutes.

B.q: A patient slept from 2235 until 0610. How long did the patient sleep?
B.why: To midnight: 2235 to 0000 = 1 h 25 min. After midnight: 6 h 10 min. Total: 7 h 35 min.

whyNot.0: This counts from 2300 and leaves out the 25 minutes before it.
whyNot.2: This finds 2400 - 2235 = 165 and reads it as 1 h 65 min (2 h 05 min).
whyNot.3: This subtracts 0610 from 2235 as if both times were on the same day.

B.q: A dose is given at 1950. The next dose is due 6 hours 30 minutes later. At what military time is it due?
B.why: 19 h 50 min + 6 h 30 min = 25 h 80 min = 26 h 20 min. Subtract 24: 0220 the next morning.

whyNot.0: This writes 80 minutes as 20 minutes without carrying the extra hour.
whyNot.2: This subtracts 12 hours from 2620 instead of 24.
whyNot.3: This does not wrap past midnight; subtract 24 hours from 2620.

B.q: A procedure that lasts 2.75 hours starts at 0915. At what military time does it end?

whyNot.0: This reads 0.75 hour as 15 minutes (2 h 15 min).
whyNot.2: This reads 2.75 hours as 2 hours 75 minutes (3 h 15 min).
whyNot.3: This reads 2.75 hours as 275 minutes (4 h 35 min).

C.q: An IV infusion runs from 2310 until 0455 the next morning. How long does it run?
C.why: 2310 to 0000 = 50 min. 0000 to 0455 = 4 h 55 min. Total: 4 h 105 min = 5 h 45 min.

whyNot.0: This turns 105 minutes into 45 minutes but does not carry the extra hour.
whyNot.2: This finds 2400 - 2310 = 90 and reads it as 90 minutes (1 h 30 min) instead of 50 minutes.
whyNot.3: This subtracts 0455 from 2310 as if both times were on the same day.

C.q: A nurse works from 0700 to 1930 with a 45-minute unpaid break. She earns $36 per hour. What is her pay for the shift?

whyNot.0: This writes 12 h 30 min as 12.3 h before taking off 0.75 h (11.55 × $36).
whyNot.2: This takes off the break as 0.45 h instead of 0.75 h (12.05 × $36).
whyNot.3: This pays the full 12.5 hours and leaves out the unpaid break.

C.q: A patient must stop drinking 6 hours 30 minutes before a procedure at 0815. What is the latest military time the patient may drink?
C.why: Borrow 1 hour: 8 h 15 min = 7 h 75 min. 7 h 75 min - 6 h 30 min = 1 h 45 min, so 0145.

whyNot.1: This subtracts 15 from 30 instead of borrowing (8 - 6 = 2, 30 - 15 = 15).
whyNot.2: This subtracts like ordinary numbers (815 - 630 = 185) and reads 1 h 85 min as 2 h 25 min.
whyNot.3: This adds 6 h 30 min to 0815 instead of counting back.

reteach.title: Think of counting up like a cashier
reteach.question: A cashier makes change by counting up from the price to the amount paid. How can counting up from the start time make elapsed time easy?

blocks.body: A cashier owed $10 on a $6.35 bill counts up: 65 cents to $7, then $3 to $10, so $3.65 change. Do the same with time. From 2235 to 0610: 25 minutes to 2300, 1 hour to midnight, 6 hours 10 minutes to 0610. Add the jumps: 7 h 35 min. Counting up avoids borrowing altogether and crosses midnight naturally.

blocks.text: Jump to the next whole hour first. Jumping from 2235 straight to 0000 as "2 hours" overcounts by 25 minutes.

explain.body: When the end minutes are smaller, take 1 hour from the hours and add 60 to the minutes: 1505 becomes 14 h 65 min.

test.q: How much time passes from 0740 to 1505?
test.why: 14 h 65 min - 7 h 40 min = 7 h 25 min. Check: 0740 + 7 h 25 min = 1505.

whyNot.1: This counts 0740 to 0800 as 30 minutes; it is 20 minutes.
whyNot.2: This subtracts like ordinary numbers (1505 - 740 = 765) and reads 7 h 65 min as 8 h 05 min.
whyNot.3: This subtracts 5 from 40 instead of borrowing (15 - 7 = 8, 40 - 5 = 35).

explain.body: Split the span at 0000: time to midnight plus time after midnight. 2050 to 0315: 3 h 10 min + 3 h 15 min = 6 h 25 min.

test.q: How long is it from 2050 to 0315 the next morning?
test.why: 2050 to 0000 = 3 h 10 min. 0000 to 0315 = 3 h 15 min. Total: 6 h 25 min.

whyNot.0: This counts 2050 to midnight as 2 h 10 min; it is 3 h 10 min.
whyNot.2: This finds 2400 - 2050 = 350 and reads it as 3 h 50 min.
whyNot.3: This subtracts 0315 from 2050 as if both times were on the same day.

explain.body: Add hours and minutes, carry each 60 minutes into an hour, and subtract 24 once the total passes 2400.

test.q: What military time is 5 hours 40 minutes after 2130?

whyNot.0: This writes 70 minutes as 10 minutes without carrying the extra hour.
whyNot.2: This subtracts 12 hours from 2710 instead of 24.
whyNot.3: This does not wrap past midnight; subtract 24 hours from 2710.

explain.body: Keep the whole hours and multiply the decimal part by 60: 1.4 h = 1 h + 0.4 × 60 min = 1 h 24 min.

test.q: How long is 1.4 hours in hours and minutes?

whyNot.0: This reads the decimal 0.4 as 4 minutes.
whyNot.2: This reads 0.4 hour as 40 minutes, as if an hour had 100 minutes.
whyNot.3: This reads 1.4 hours as 140 minutes (2 h 20 min).
